issue84.title: P0: prepare Gate 1 and explicit P3/P5 selection for UAV APP-completion baseline
issue84.body:
Process: P0 governance — new baseline decision package.
Deliverable: one reviewable Gate 1 proposal package for the exact full N=1 request-correlated APP-completion model accepted and merged in PR #83, including hash pins, reproducibility audit, proposed operational selection rules and a concrete Integrator decision.
Atomic IDs: N/A — coordination-only. R07 remains owned by Issue #80.
Owner/account-id: vadimnbkg (authenticated existing account).
Reviewer/Integrator: artmus208 proposed; independent decision required.
Base ref: origin/read.
Base commit: 61386aa358805082b705dcd00c8cbfde5fb98248 (published read after merged #83 and #81).
Task branch: codex/vadimnbkg/84-uav-completion-baseline.
Target branch: read.

## Authorization and boundary
The user explicitly chose "Новый baseline модели #83 — следующий обязательный шаг" when requesting a prompt for a new chat. This Issue materializes that governance assignment. PR #83 acceptance/merge is accepted candidate input; it does not itself freeze/activate a baseline or transfer verification.
Prepare a concrete reviewable package first. Only the initial evidence scope below is activated by this assignment. Operational manifests require the explicit manifest-specific scope/Integrator disposition before modification. Do not infer that disposition from the existence of this Issue.

## Initial Write scope
- evidence/governance/uav-service-completion-baseline-20261002/**

All other paths are read-only, including the accepted candidate, historical baselines, current.json, collaboration-v2.yaml, manuscript, production sources and previous evidence.
Proposed phase-two manifest-specific scope to review in this same governance Issue:
- manifests/baselines/uav-service-completion-r1.yaml
- manifests/collaboration-v2.yaml (only explicit selection policy for this baseline)
No default pointer replacement; no edits to historical model/generator input pins.
Include a machine-applicable proposed patch under the initial evidence scope. Actual phase-two paths remain inactive until Integrator approval is recorded.

## Inputs and accepted dependencies
- v2 activation: https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/issues/64#issuecomment-5878071165
- Historical family preparation and limited P1/P2 decision: https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/pull/73#issuecomment-5890790922
- Historical family P4 activation: https://github.com/artmus208/uppaal_sdn_isac/pull/75#issuecomment-5891123461 (historical scope retained).
- Accepted candidate: Issue #82 / PR #83, head fdbfd5619385eae31101dcfc285010b96cc85b45, merge 07e45268bbfbb4c1293e4e4f4227792794583509.
- Candidate directory: evidence/instantiation/uav-service-completion-candidate/**.
- Candidate model SHA256: b8ab50e112b71491f8242789cc7906497baf8440c473d7a5a4d5214840187e02.
- Published input HEAD/tree and actual per-run source checkpoints are distinct; preserve their provenance rather than relabelling execution.
- PR #81 is a accepted failure scenario on the old 50-process model, not a trace of this 51-process candidate.
- Existing shared governance scopes must be rechecked before any operational manifest write.

Proposed baseline ID: uav-service-completion-r1-20261002, exactly N=1, 51 processes. No N=2/3/4 inclusion or cost/verification result transfer.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Audit immutable accepted inputs, source/raw archives and deterministic generation; preserve every scientific model/query byte.
2. Pin model, deterministic transformer/generator and input-source hashes, all parameters, 51-process instance vector/order, query formulas/hashes, tool-version evidence, relevant commits and reproducibility environment.
3. Describe new service semantics: admitted request/sample correlation, actual sensing, queued result token and eligible MAC service, lossy delivery, APP receipt, service bound 40 from actual request, sample freshness <5, failure/timeout/cancel outcomes. Distinguish user-confirmed bounds from new abstract assumptions and missing physical calibration.
4. Propose P1/P2 applicability for this changed-model scope. Do not claim whole-system equivalence or an accepted new scientific disposition solely from PR merge.
5. Distinguish frozen inputs from property results: healthy simulation/replay 100 transitions, property_verdict/query_hash null; eleven query verdicts still open. Prior 50-process P3/P4 evidence remains confined to its own configuration.
6. Draft an explicit baseline-selection policy for future P3/P5 Issues, preserving historical default/current pointer and old P4 selection. Baseline selection is not execution authorization, P3 acceptance or R07 closure.
7. Prepare a standalone audit/checker under the initial scope and meaningful negative controls for hash drift, vector/parameter/query mismatch and wrong cross-baseline evidence. Read-only audits and tests only, no native UPPAAL campaign.
8. Supply proposed manifest, decision documents, exact proposed operational patch, checks and durable PR to read with handoff.
9. Provide concrete Integrator disposition separating (a) P1/P2 applicability, (b) input freeze/Gate 1, (c) activation after exact merge SHA/time, and (d) still-open verification properties.
10. Never set accepted/frozen/activated flags or report Gate 1 passed before the corresponding independent decision. The author does not merge/accept their own governance result.

## Planned outputs
README.md, proposed baseline YAML, input-hashes.json, parameter/vector/query inventories, standalone audit and controls, proposed-operational.patch, proposed-integrator-decision.md, HANDOFF.md.
Candidate/operational exact filenames may adapt after schema inspection, but no broad refactoring or rewriting historical inputs.

Status: ready for isolated governance-package preparation; input freeze, operational scope activation and final scientific decisions pending.
